title: AI Ethics
description: Introduction to ethical issues that arise in the use of artificial intelligence (AI). Includes whether AI systems are capable of ethical decision making; how the use of artificial intelligence intersects with and affects bias, privacy, accountability and justice; whether AI should be used to make vital decisions in politics, medicine and warfare.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PHIL 219, PHIL 290 (if taken in the same topic).
